# IDEA

## Problem and target users

<!-- Describe the current task, friction, audience and usage context. -->

## Desired outcomes

<!-- Describe the outcome and how it improves the user's task. -->

## MVP requirements

<!-- List mandatory behaviors with stable IDs such as MVP-1. Include the delivery profile. -->

## Exclusions

<!-- Set explicit scope boundaries. -->

## Future enhancements

<!-- List optional ideas that do not affect MVP acceptance. -->

## Input contract

<!-- Define source, format/schema, limits, trust, validation and a synthetic example. -->

## Output contract

<!-- Define format/schema, destination, a synthetic example and failure behavior. -->

## Technical approach and alternatives

<!-- Recommend a minimal approach, tradeoffs, feasibility evidence and what remains to validate. -->

## Complexity and operating costs

<!-- Estimate implementation effort and drivers. State usage assumptions, currency,
estimated operating cost, approved cap and what requires approval. -->

## Privacy, security, licensing and risks

<!-- Cover classification, retention, handling of untrusted inputs, rights and
provenance. State material risks and mitigations. -->

## Assumptions and open decisions

<!-- Distinguish confirmed needs, defaults and blocking questions. Write None where applicable. -->

## Acceptance and evaluation

<!-- Map each MVP requirement to a measurable threshold and verification method.
Include synthetic fixtures and at least one negative case. -->
